protocol.role: development test of an explicit holding-cost selector

base_protocol.arrival_model: independent Poisson arrivals per second; common tape across budgets
base_protocol.dispatch: global synchronous frames; released jobs only; FIFO within class
base_protocol.score: queue weighted actual frame departures divided by actual frame duration
base_protocol.budget_unit: candidate construction or feasibility attempt; seeds included
base_protocol.stopping_rule: stop arrivals at horizon, then drain the same finite prefix

protocol.eligibility: Q dot D(a)/tau(a) >= maximum paid homogeneous-seed support
protocol.candidate_generation: same budgeted construction, order and max-support pruning as frozen v4
protocol.cost_scope: minimize H only over already paid eligible candidates; no global holding-cost guarantee
protocol.arrival_rate_input: Lambda=sum(registered class arrival rates); fixed throughout arrival window and drain
protocol.drain_cost_interpretation: stationary-arrival proxy, not actual conditional arrivals after the cutoff
protocol.reference: v4 support selector at K120; K120 of the new rule is not a support-exact reference
protocol.stopping_rule: run the full development roster once; no coefficient or budget selection from the results

excluded_actions.reason: resident class has no arrivals in the three-class q01 protocol

certificates.arrival_model: independent Poisson job arrivals in physical time
certificates.drift_bound: E[Delta V | Q] <= B + tau_max*C - tau_min*effective_slack*sum(Q)
certificates.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

certificates.arrival_model: independent Poisson job arrivals in physical time
certificates.drift_bound: E[Delta V | Q] <= B + tau_max*C - tau_min*effective_slack*sum(Q)
certificates.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

certificates.arrival_model: independent Poisson job arrivals in physical time
certificates.drift_bound: E[Delta V | Q] <= B + tau_max*C - tau_min*effective_slack*sum(Q)
certificates.capacity_basis: lanes times convex hull of all admitted lane requirements/max(1,duration)

limitations: The holding objective is a one-frame proxy. A lower objective does not certify lower long-run mean flow.
For homogeneous frames whose admitted jobs all finish at tau, H=sum(Q)+Lambda*tau/2; the departure count cancels, so this objective favors short frames subject to the seed floor.
The frozen max-support pruning can omit candidates with better holding cost; only the paid eligible pool is optimized.
The stationary Lambda remains fixed in the drain phase; it does not describe the actual zero arrivals there.
The selected action may have less support than an exactly solved support search. Its gap and exact flag refer to that actual selection.
Candidate attempts retain the original budget unit; holding-cost evaluations, offset reads and wall time are additional reported work.
These reused development seeds and the deterministic cache model provide no new independent or physical-hardware confirmation.
